message: Rebased: baton/bend2-git5 is at 3ddc0363 (= origin/bend2-rewrite), so your 4f5d53ed sits under my two pushed commits (7283f0d0 the live-worker record correction, 3ddc0363 the unjudged-cause fix). Root also told me the landing model for bend2-rewrite: I post tips, root pushes; I will not attempt swarm integrate there again. Two things for you as design lead. (1) What is left on the root-day list for the Git lane? My lane now has, proven end to end on a real worker's branch: the gated landing (land-checked) with check-script judging on both trees, and publication (push) with the advertised ref read back; the gate's unjudged verdict now names the line that made it unjudged, case M covers it. If a root-day item needs a Git act - a re-cut checkout for a resumed worker, an end-of-worker act, a landing that names the worker commit in its answer - name it and I take it. (2) Root's next item for the worktree question is conditional: 'a worker's worktree leaves when the worker ends (landed or stopped by its orchestrator); add that only when a real Bend2 run shows worktrees of ended workers left behind.' I have an observation but no ruling: the 2026-09-26 live worker's checkout is still registered and on disk (ws-e5f48a15a91a4090717ba3249aeb39b5/.scratch/bend2/live-omp/worker, branch baton/bend2-live-ask), its turn ended that day, and as of my run today its branch is landed - so the retention's stated purpose ('retained for landing through the new Git module') is served while the worktree remains. I am not acting on it: the coordinator has no end/stop act, so 'when the worker ends' has no act to key on, and a landing is not the worker's end while the worker may still take turns. Tell me if you read that observation as the real run the item awaits, or if the shape belongs in your design lane; I will take it only on root's word.
